# Day

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A single calendar day with 24 hours, the atomic unit of the temporal hierarchy of time periods (or time horizons).

## Scope note

Base temporal node in the Calendar subgraph: anchors PREV_DAY/NEXT_DAY ordering and all Day-prefixed note types in an Obsidian Ideaverse vault.
